drawings.description: un carré encadré : $u$ — $uv$ en haut, $1$ — $v$ en bas, avec deux diagonales parallèles $1$–$u$ et $v$–$uv$.

drawings.notes: In a drawn frame: u (top left) - uv (top right), 1 (bottom left) - v (bottom right); short strokes for the sides u-uv and 1-v and the two parallel diagonals 1-u and v-uv. The vertical sides are not drawn.

drawings.description: un triangle ; puis un pentagone de sommets reliés à un centre (l'étoile d'un sommet de l'icosaèdre), une face marquée $\alpha$.
drawings.kind: triangle; star of a vertex (pentagon joined to its centre)
drawings.notes: Above: a triangle, pencil strokes doubled. Below: a pentagon with its five vertices joined to a centre (the star of a vertex of the icosahedron), two edges inked heavier; the face marked alpha is the upper one (the letter is small and overinked).

drawings.description: dans le plan, les vecteurs $e_1$, $e_2$, $e_3 = e_1 + e_2$ (diagonale du carré) et $e_4 = e_1 + \lambda e_2$.

drawings.notes: From the origin (bottom left): e_1 (right), e_2 (up), the square on them with the diagonal e_3 = e_1 + e_2, and the longer vector e_4 = e_1 + lambda e_2. The right side of the square is faint (pencil).

drawings.description: à gauche de l'énoncé, l'étoile pentagonale d'un sommet $u_0$, avec une arête épaissie vers $u_1$.
drawings.kind: star of a vertex (pentagon)
drawings.notes: Pentagonal star of u_0: five spokes and the pentagon. Two spokes are thickened, towards the top right vertex and towards the right vertex labelled u_1 (the transcription names one thickened edge, towards u_1).

drawings.description: l'étoile du sommet $u$ : un pentagone $v_0, v_1, \ldots, v_{-1} = v_4$, une flèche de rotation au centre.
drawings.kind: star of a vertex with rotation arrow
drawings.notes: Star of u, every edge drawn between the same computed vertices: on the right the inked part of the pentagon, u-v_1 and v_1-v_0 heavy, v_0-v_{-1}, and the spokes u-v_0 (doubled in ink, drawn once) and u-v_{-1}; the rotation arrow at the centre, head at the top. On the left v_2 (the hand stops it at the label u, extended to u here), the faint pencil chord v_2-v_1, and the short ink stroke from v_2 towards v_1. Below: the strokes he adds towards a further vertex t (written under the figure, not in the transcription): v_3-t (a second, fainter stroke beside it is not drawn), a curve from u to t, the stroke from v_{-1} towards t (it stops short, as on the page), and a long curve from above u down towards t. Left out: the matrix (alpha alpha' / beta 0) at the top left, its bracket line and the short stroke from it towards v_1 (formula, in the transcription's text), and the blot under the label v_2 (perhaps a struck label). Still differs: the label v_3 is placed after the transcription (no legible label at the lower left vertex); u-v_3 is not drawn (no stroke on the page), so the pentagon is not closed on the left. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: un réseau de faces de l'icosaèdre autour de $u$ et $u_0$, sommets marqués $v_1$, $v_3'$, $v_4'$, $v_2$, $v_6'$, $v_3$, $v_4$, $v_2'$, $v_1'$ ; une face hachurée.
drawings.kind: net of icosahedron faces around two vertices
drawings.notes: Every edge drawn between the same computed vertices. Top: the quadrilateral A (top, labelled v_1) - B (v'_3) - C (right, v_0) with the heavy diagonal A-C and the heavy vertical A-D down to the centre D; the face A-D-C hatched; on the left F (v'_4) - A heavy, F-E (E = v_2) heavy, the faint chord A-E. Middle row E-D-C. Below: the fan of D: D-G (v_3), D-H (v_4), E-G, C-H, and G-H; on the right C-I (I = v'_2) and the stroke from I towards H, which stops short; on the left E-J (J = v'_6) and the stroke from J towards G, which stops short; at the bottom the two strokes from K (v'_1) towards G and H, which stop short. Labels at \small, where he wrote them. Reading differs from the earlier redraw: the top vertex is labelled v_1 (not u_0), the left vertex v_2 and the right vertex v_0 (written "v_o"): the order v_3, v_4, v_0, v_1, v_2 around the centre then matches the star of u of 01-5, so the unlabelled centre D is u. Still differs: the blot under D (perhaps the label u, overinked) is not drawn; the ink blot at B is not drawn as a point; a faint pencil vertical between C and H and the doubling of F-E are left out. Disagreement: the transcription's list of labels has v_2 but not v_0, and names u, u_0, which are not written on the figure. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.disagreement: The figure is labelled v_0 at the right vertex (written v_o), which the transcription's list omits; u and u_0 are not written on the figure (the centre is unlabelled, under a blot).

drawings.description: En marge gauche, un triangle : sommets $V_h$ (en haut), $V_i$ et $V_j$ (en bas) ; côtés marqués $G_j$ (à gauche), $G_i$ (à droite), $G_k$ (en bas).

drawings.description: un carré dont les sommets sont joints par les deux diagonales en pointillé, marqué $Q_1$ et $Q_2$, avec une flèche vers $Q_1$ ; à côté : « On a le troisième coin »

drawings.description: un pentagone avec son étoile de diagonales intérieures, en marge
drawings.kind: pentagon with interior strokes
drawings.notes: Pentagon, its five sides drawn between the same computed vertices (on the page the left side stops short of the left vertex and resumes below it; joined here). The second strokes doubling the lower left side and crossing the lower right side below the bottom vertex are drawn as on the page, as is the tail stroke leaving the lower left side towards the text at the bottom left. Inside there are only short broken strokes and dots, not full diagonals: they are drawn one by one where they stand. These fragments do not line up into the five diagonals, so the "star of diagonals" of the transcription is a reading that the redraw does not impose (perhaps an erased pencil star whose ink remains in pieces); the scribble at the far bottom left belongs to the text line and is left out. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.disagreement: The transcription reads "son étoile de diagonales intérieures"; the page shows only short broken strokes and dots inside the pentagon, which do not form the five diagonals.

drawings.description: à droite, un parallélépipède en perspective : sommets marqués par des cercles, certaines arêtes renforcées à l'encre brune, d'autres en pointillé, flèches de rotation autour de deux axes ; étiquettes « $t\ldots$ », « $c$ ». À côté : « $\Sigma_a, \Pi_a$ ». Au-dessus, un petit losange et une flèche circulaire.
drawings.kind: parallelepiped in perspective with rotation arrows
drawings.notes: Bbox widened to take in the rhombus, the circular arrow and Sigma_a, Pi_a. Parallelepiped, every edge drawn between the same computed corners: top face TL - TB (ringed, top) - TR - TF (heavy dot), with TR-TF heavy and TL-TF dotted (a row of dots); the left edge TL-BL heavy; the front vertical TF-BF (BF ringed, bottom); bottom BL-BF, BF-BR thin; the right edge TR-BR thin with a dotted line beside it; from the heavy dot BB, BB-BR heavy and BB-BL dotted. Rotation arrows: one about a vertical axis on the top face, one on the left face (head to the left), one on the right face (head at the lower right), and a small one outside at the left. Labels at \small: "t..." at the top right corner, "t.." on the heavy edge TR-TF, "t..." and "c" by the dot TF, the "!" under the left arrow; "Sigma_a, Pi_a" at the right. Above at the left: the small rhombus (left side doubled) and the circular arrow. Still differs: the corner BB has no vertical edge up to TB (only the "!" stroke there), so which corners are hidden is not settled by the figure, and the redraw does not complete it; the brown ink of the transcription cannot be told on a grey render; the dash with two dots at the top right (to the right of the rhombus) is left out, as unrelated to the figure. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: cube en perspective, avec arêtes renforcées ($a$, $\bar a$, $\bar a'$), sommets cerclés, diagonales, flèches de rotation et étiquettes $f$, $f'$, $f''$.
drawings.kind: cube with reinforced edges, diagonals and rotation arrows
drawings.notes: Bbox re-centred on the cube. Corners computed once, every edge drawn between the same points: the front top edge P1-P2 through the small dot M; the heavy left edge P1-BL (labelled a-bar', heavy blot at BL, drawn as a point); the heavy edge P2-P3 (a, heavy blot at P3, drawn as a point); the edge from P1 to the back corner Q drawn with cross ticks (a-bar above it); the top back edge from the ring beside Q to P3; the bottom edge BL-BR (BR ringed); the edge P2-BR with ticks; the right edge P3-R3 and the bottom right edge BR-R3; the vertical from M down to the bottom edge. Inside: the long thin line from Q down to the left, the short stroke below Q, the stroke from M up to the right (crossing the f), the hidden stroke from BL towards the back, an arc and a dashed stroke in the front face; on the right face the diagonal from P2 towards R3 (stopping short at both ends, as on the page), the diagonal rising from the edge BR-R3 and stopping short of P3-R3, and the horizontal stroke between them. Rotation arrows: on the left face (C-shaped) and under f on the top face. Labels at \small: a-bar, a-bar', a, f (top face), f' (right face, legible on this crop), f'' (front face). Still differs: the ring stands above and to the right of the corner Q where the ticked edge, the long line and the short stroke meet, and is drawn where it stands; the small asterisk on the edge P2-BR and the dashes on the hidden strokes are simplified; which corner is hidden is a reading. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: second cube, arêtes $b$, $b'$ renforcées, faces $f$, $f'$, étiquettes $t''$, $a'$.
drawings.kind: cube with reinforced edges
drawings.notes: Bbox re-centred on the second cube. Where his strokes meet, they meet at one computed corner: A (top left: the top left edge, the left vertical and the dotted front top edge), B (front top right: the dotted edge, the heavy edge b and the front right vertical), C (top right: the heavy edge b and the top back edge), E (bottom left: the left vertical and the heavy bottom edge b'). Elsewhere the strokes stop short as on the page and are drawn so: the top left edge and the top back edge do not reach each other (the back top corner is not drawn), the back right vertical stops below C and above the bottom, the front right vertical and the heavy edge b' stop short of the bottom front corner, and the bottom right edge (drawn with heavy dots) stops short at both ends. Also drawn: the hidden middle vertical, the oblique inner stroke at the lower left and the short stroke at the lower right, two curved arrows (one hooked down on the front face, one on the right face). Labels at \small: f (top), f' (right face), b on the heavy top edge (overinked blot there), b' over the heavy bottom edge, t'' at the bottom of the front face. Still differs: the small marks strung along the two dotted edges (letters or ticks, not legible) are left out; the mark at the lower left of the front face, read here as a' after the transcription, is not legible on the crop and is placed by position; the curved stroke right of t'' (part of a label?) is left out. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: Petit cube : la face $f$ de sommets $s, t, s', t'$ et la face $f'$ de sommets $t, s, t'', s''$, adjacentes le long de l'arête $a$ entre $s$ et $t$ ; arêtes $a'$, $a''$ marquées, ainsi que la diagonale $i$.

drawings.notes: Bbox tightened on the cube. Corners computed once: top face f = s', t', s, t (s'-t' labelled a', t'-s at the back, the front top edge s'-t heavy, and the heavy curved edge a = t-s); right face f' = t, s, t'', s'' (the heavy front vertical t-s'', the back vertical s-t'', and the doubled heavy edge a'' = s''-t''); front face down to the bottom edge; at the back, the hidden bottom edge from the back bottom left corner to t'' (broken where it passes behind the front vertical and stopping short of t'', as on the page) and the receding bottom left edge (stopping short of its back corner). Still differs: the corner s is under a large blot; the label s is placed at the blot's right (the mark there may be an overwritten s), and the scribble inside the top face is not legible and is left out. drawings.description: Deux cubes en perspective. Sur le petit, en haut à gauche, les arêtes portent $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$, $a'$, $b'$ et, en dessous, $a+\alpha$, $b+\alpha$, $c+\alpha$, $d+\alpha$. Sur le grand, les arêtes portent, cerclées, $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$, $u$, et $a+\alpha = a'$ (cerclé $a'$), puis $b+\alpha$, $c+\alpha$, $d+\alpha$, $u+c-a$ ; sur une face : $v = u - (d-b)$ (signe surchargé).
drawings.kind: two cubes with edge labels
drawings.notes: Small cube (top left) on eight computed corners: front face a (top), a' (left), b' (right, heavy, doubled in ink), the bottom edge; receding edges d, b and the back edge c on top; the back right vertical, the bottom right receding edge, and the three hidden edges (thin) meeting at the back bottom left corner. Labels at \small as he placed them: c, d, a, b, a', b', and below d+alpha, c+alpha, b+alpha, a+alpha. Large cube on computed corners: front face with the top edge (circled a), the left vertical (circled u, ending in an arrowhead before the bottom corner, as on the page), the right vertical and the bottom edge (a+alpha = circled a'); top receding edges (circled d on the left one, circled b on the right one) and the back top edge (circled c), meeting at the back corners; back right vertical; bottom right receding edge (b+alpha); the hidden back bottom edge (c+alpha), the short hidden stroke from the front bottom left corner (d+alpha) and a short fragment of the hidden left vertical. Inside: u+c-a, v = u-(d-b) (the sign before (d-b) is overwritten), and v+(c-a) = u at the right. Still differs: the hidden back left vertical is not drawn on the page except for one fragment, so its corner is computed from the two drawn edges; the overwritten mark by c+alpha in the small cube and the stray dots and ticks are left out; positions of the small labels of the small cube are read off a cramped area. The typed text showing through from the back of the sheet is not drawn. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.
